headline: Iran Exempts Select Countries from Hormuz Restrictions Amid US Blockade
summary: Iran granted commercial vessels from China, India, Iraq, and Qatar exemptions from restrictions in the Strait of Hormuz, potentially complicating the US naval blockade.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most critical oil transit and shipping chokepoints, making access rules vital for global energy flows.

impacts.name: Energy Shipping
impacts.why: Selective exemptions in the Strait of Hormuz alter regional shipping routes and oil transit dynamics.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Granting specific countries passage through a key oil shipping route challenges naval blockade enforcement and directly affects regional energy logistics.
